A standardised system, described by Raadsma et al. [31], was used to score fleece rot incidence and severity independently of the incidence of flystrike (occurring naturally or induced). Scores of 0 to 5 for fleece rot sever- ity were given as follows: 0 = No bacterial colour or crust- ing; 1 = Band of bacterial staining < 10 mm wide with no crusting; 2 = Band of bacterial staining > 10 mm wide with no crusting; 3 = Band of crusting < 5 mm wide with or without bacterial staining; 4 = Band of crusting from 5 to 10 mm wide with or without bacterial staining; 5 = Band of crusting > 10 mm wide with or without bacterial staining. Each animal was scored at four sites by parting the fleece along the animal's backline (back of neck, wither, loin and rump).
